name: search_files_by_filename
description:
Get a file from a cloud drive by its filename. It returns a list of files.
Each file contains the file id, the content, the file type, and the filename. Returns the IDENTIFIERS held here (an index), not the records — the region is far too large to return at once. Take the id you need and fetch that single record with this region's per-record getter.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The name of the file to retrieve.
